_readme: Single source of truth for Real Zero public contact numbers. Edit ONLY this file, then run: node scripts/contact.mjs --write

current.role: Public support and sales line (WhatsApp Business + voice)

_retired_note: When you swap numbers: move the old e164 string into phone.retired, set the new one as current, run --write, commit. CI then fails forever if a retired number reappears anywhere.
